description: ASP.NET Core authorization for TruthWeaver rules: a rule requirement and its handler for named policies and resource-based checks, an authorization context with claim, role, authentication and owner predicates, fail-closed results that keep the Decision, and problem-details responses.
Dependency-free contracts for TruthWeaver: TruthValue, Decision, Fault, IPredicate and the predicate schema types, for a project that only implements predicates.
Test support for TruthWeaver: Decision assertions, rule equivalence and rewrite assertions, a predicate harness, a rule fuzzer, fake predicates, and declarative YAML rule tests with stub values.
The truthweaver-tui terminal workbench: edit a TruthWeaver rule in rule text, JSON or YAML with live diagnostics, undo and redo, format, and a linked canonical view.

Policy sets for TruthWeaver: policies with a target, an effect and a priority, combined by deny-overrides, permit-overrides or first-applicable under Strong Kleene logic, with a fail-closed decision that never turns Unknown into a permit.
Roslyn source generator for TruthWeaver: mark a static method with [Predicate] and the generator emits the registration code and predicate schema at compile time, with no reflection.
The truthweaver command line: validate, convert, format, print, export, report, diff, evaluate and test TruthWeaver rules in rule text, JSON or YAML, with stub values for the predicates.
YAML support for TruthWeaver: read and write rule trees and query YAML documents as a data source, isolated in its own package so only consumers of YAML take the YamlDotNet dependency.
Compile-once, evaluate-many Strong Kleene (K3) rule engine for .NET: parse a rule from text, JSON or a builder into an immutable tree, analyze it and evaluate it with True, False and Unknown.
JSON data source for TruthWeaver variable references: JsonDataSource answers JSONPath (RFC 9535) queries against a JSON document and JsonQueryValidator checks a query when a rule compiles.
Ready-made predicates for TruthWeaver covering strings, numbers, dates, collections, regular expressions and types, built on TruthWeaver.Abstractions alone.
